in_sanskrit.name: क्रुपा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the root 'krush' (to be moved), hence, one who moves the heart with compassion or mercy.

in_hindi.name: कृपा
in_hindi.long_meaning: प्रार्थना (prarthana) - prayer or request; संतुष्टि (santushti) - satisfaction; कौशल्य (kausali) - skill or ability.

in_tamil.name: க்ருபா
in_tamil.long_meaning: குழந்தையை கோபம் கொடுத்திருந்தது (kuzhandaiyai kopam kodutirundadu) - one who has the heart filled with compassion towards others.

in_telugu.name: కృపా
in_telugu.long_meaning: మృధెద్దు (mridhuddu) - gentle; ప్రధన (pradhana) - principal, primary; దోశ (dosham) - absence of.

in_marathi.name: Krupa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Compassion, Mercy, Grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krupa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krupa is a Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘Karuna’ which signifies compassion, mercy, and grace. In Hindu mythology, the goddess of compassion is called Goddess Kali or Goddess Shiva's consort Parvati, who is the embodiment of this virtue. Krupa is an auspicious name for a baby girl, symbolizing the mother's endless love and care towards her child.
